entities.name: Apostle Peter (Simon Peter)
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Chief among the twelve apostles, originally a fisherman. Jesus declared him the "rock" upon which the church would be built (Matthew 16:18). Leader of the early Jerusalem church, preached at Pentecost, and according to tradition was martyred in Rome under Nero (c. 64 CE).
